policy: Only promote exactly four editorial edges with relationship-specific evidence; no changes to relation identities, types, notes, or other records. Treat formal relation as domain-qualified; source attachment does not imply universal scientific proof.

new.sourceLocator: Wetterich (1993), Phys. Lett. B 301:90–94, publisher abstract: scale-dependent effective action and continuous RG flow.
new.evidenceNote: Wetterich derives an exact evolution equation for a scale-dependent effective action, a functional formulation of renormalization-group flow. This is a formal methodological relation; practical truncations need not be exact, and this edge does not imply that every RG scheme is a functional RG.

new.sourceLocator: Coecke and Duncan (2011), arXiv:0906.4725v3, abstract: ZX calculus via dagger symmetric monoidal categories and complementarity.
new.evidenceNote: Coecke and Duncan explicitly present ZX as a graphical calculus within dagger symmetric monoidal category methods, identifying complementary observables and phase structure. This establishes a categorical derivation/representation link, not completeness for arbitrary quantum processes or classical diagrams.

new.sourceLocator: Simmons-Duffin, arXiv:1602.07982v1, Sec. 1.3 (bootstrap philosophy), Ch. 9.1–9.4 (crossing, scalar bootstrap, bounds).
new.evidenceNote: The conformal-bootstrap method imposes conformal symmetry, crossing and unitarity on CFT operator data rather than selecting a microscopic Lagrangian. It derives consistency constraints on conformal field theories; it is not an assertion that every CFT is solved or all quantum field theories are conformal.

new.sourceLocator: Evenbly and Vidal, arXiv:1106.1082v1, abstract: explicit comparison of MPS, PEPS and MERA tensor-network geometries.
new.evidenceNote: Evenbly and Vidal compare MERA with MPS and PEPS as distinct tensor-network ansatz families, showing that MERA has a multiscale geometry. This navigation edge means an additional tensor-network family, not a claim that MERA formally subsumes every MPS or provides an exact representation for all states.
